result.summary: Found 1 minor styling issue with the promotional banner text contrast/opacity.

issues.description: The '3 free deliveries for you' promotional banner text appears washed out/low opacity against the light green background, making it slightly hard to read compared to the bold 'Order now' button below it.
issues.suggestion: Increase the opacity or darken the text color of the banner heading and subtext to improve readability and visual consistency with the rest of the UI.
